spec.description:
Bradford Gold Batts are Australia's leading glasswool thermal
and acoustic insulation batts for residential ceilings and walls. Manufactured
from up to 80% recycled glass with FBS-1 bio-soluble formulation and low-itch
Comfort Touch technology, they form a continuous, resilient thermal barrier that
reduces winter heat loss and summer heat gain by up to 45%. Available in
R-values from R1.5 to R2.0 for walls and R2.5 to R4.1 for standard ceilings,
they are non-combustible, low allergen, Sensitive Choice approved, and backed by
a 70-year warranty.
features:
Reduces home heating and cooling energy use
by up to 45%
Manufactured from up to 80% recycled glass

Low-itch Comfort
Touch technology for softer handling and reduced airborne dust
Non-combustible when tested in accordance with AS 1530.1

Approved partner of
National Asthma Council Sensitive Choice program

Will not slump, shrink, pack
down, or deteriorate over the building lifetime

Wall batts treated with water
repellent to resist moisture wicking

Available in standard 430mm and 580mm
widths to suit 450mm and 600mm framing centres

Sized to fit standard
Australian timber and steel stud framing

Backed by CSR Bradford's 70-year
product performance warranty

technical.value: 1160 mm length x 430 mm or 580 mm width

Ignitability: 0,
Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke Developed: 0-1

Less than 0.2% by volume after 4 days
at 50°C, 95% RH

spec.fire:
Non-combustible to AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 1530.3:
Ignitability 0, Spread of Flame 0, Heat Evolved 0, Smoke Developed 0-1; Meets
NCC fire hazard property requirements
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 3999,
NCC Volume 1 and Volume 2 / ABCB Housing Provisions Part 13.2
spec.sustainability:
Contains up to 80% recycled glass content; bio-soluble FBS-1
formulation; zero ODP; Sensitive Choice certified
install:
Turn off power
at the main switchboard before entering ceiling space or touching wall
cavities

Fit batts snugly between timber or steel framing members without
gaps or compression

For ceilings, lay batts flat between ceiling joists
covering the plasterboard completely

At ceiling eaves, maintain a 20mm gap
between insulation and roof cladding/sarking

Maintain minimum 50mm clearance
around non-IC rated downlights, exhaust fans, and flues as per AS 3999

For
external walls, install water-repellent batts between studs and secure with wall
wrap before brickwork or cladding
selection_checklist:
Confirm
application area (ceiling vs external walls)

Determine required R-value to
comply with 7-star NatHERS / NCC climate zone targets

Measure joist or stud
spacing (450mm centres require 430mm batts; 600mm centres require 580mm batts)
Check wall cavity depth (75mm for 70mm studs, 90mm for 90mm studs)

Verify
downlight IC ratings to establish required clearances
limitations:
Do not compress batts into cavities narrower than nominal
thickness as this reduces thermal R-value

Must be protected from continuous
water exposure and prolonged outdoor weather

Maintain electrical safety
clearances around recessed electrical equipment

use_cases:
Insulating roof spaces in new
residential builds and renovations to achieve 7-star NatHERS energy ratings
Retrofitting existing ceiling cavities to lower heating and cooling bills

Installing in external timber or steel stud walls behind brick veneer or
lightweight cladding
not_for: Bushfire BAL-FZ roof zones (use Fireseal FZ)
